source: 1413 长夜月 终结技 (skill 141303) 的**等级口径**: 她的终结技在文档里按 Lv10 引用（#1[i]% 长夜生命上限的冰属性伤害按 Lv10 行读）
note: The file stating **which level its numbers were quoted at** (M-32), replacing the `damage_level: 10` that her ultimate's damage rule used to carry. ⚠ A level is a fact about the skill (every effect reads it, and a 星魂's raise composes with it), while `damage_level` pins one effect to one row — the difference only shows once something raises a level, which is exactly what the 星魂 sentences do. ⚠ Base 1 in the engine, so 「quoted at Lv10」 is +9. ⚠ Unconditional, and not a mechanic. ⚠ Her ultimate's parameter table has 15 rows, so a later raise stays inside it; going past the table fails loudly at fire time.

source: 1413 长夜月 天赋: 「进入战斗时召唤忆灵「长夜」。」
note: The summoning clause only; 「长夜」's panel is derived from her in resources/memosprites/1413.json, and everything else her talent says (the CRIT DMG on HP loss, 【忆质】) is not authored yet. No `target`: a memosprite belongs to its summoner, so there is nothing to point at -- SUMMON refuses one rather than ignoring it. Firing this twice keeps the memosprite already out (the op is idempotent per summoner), which is what 「若已在场…」 implies; the refresh variant is not modelled. A character with a SUMMON rule but no memosprite spec is refused when the character is built (CharacterFactory), not mid-battle.

source: 1413 长夜月 终结技 晚安，全世界无眠 (skill 141303, Ultimate/AoEAttack/Ice): 「召唤忆灵「长夜」，随后使忆灵「长夜」对敌方全体造成等同于「长夜」#1[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害…」
note: Her ultimate's damage is NOT hers to deal, and this rule is where that is said. ⚠ Without it the engine's ordinary damage path swings 141303's own `damage_list` with HER attack as the base (measured 2026-09-27: 8818.5 on 1002011 with an empty table), and the ULT_CAST rule below swings the memosprite's Max-HP share on top -- two damage instances where the document describes one, the first of them scaled off the wrong attribute (M-40). ⚠ It has to be CAST_SETUP and not ULT_CAST: the cast events fire AFTER the damage has been expanded, so a rule there can only describe the swing, never prevent it. ⚠ `actor == self` is required (CAST_SETUP reaches every character's table) and the op verifies it as well rather than trusting the condition. ⚠ `skill: "ULTRA"` is likewise a check, not decoration: the condition DSL has no variable for "which slot is being cast", so this comparison IS the gate -- naming SKILL here would delegate her Skill instead. ⚠ Its sibling is the ULT_CAST rule below, which delivers the swing this one hands over (SUMMON + COMMAND_SUMMON); the toughness (90, from 141303's own `stance_list`) rides along THERE, because a delegated cast expands no damage of its own and therefore removes no toughness of its own.

source: 1413 长夜月 忆灵技能3 与夜，形影，不离: 「被召唤时，使自身立即行动。」
note: The memosprite's own skill, expressed as a rule on its summoner -- which is where the engine's tables live. ⚠ `actor == summon` is required: SUMMONED is delivered to every character's table, so without it a teammate's memosprite entering would also advance HERS. ⚠ `percent: 1.0` skips all of the target's REMAINING time to act, so the memosprite acts immediately -- that is what 立即行动 means, and 0.5 would be 行动提前 50%. ⚠ The event is fired AFTER the unit is in the action bar (Battle.fireSummoned, drained by processRequests): an ADVANCE against a unit that has no signal yet is silently lost, and this rule is exactly the kind that would expose it.

source: 1413 长夜月 忆灵技能2 孤独，浮游，漆黑 (效果ID 10000011): 「「长夜」免疫控制类负面状态，被攻击的概率提高。」
note: 「免疫控制类负面状态」 and 克拉拉's 「抵抗控制类负面状态的概率提高35%」 are ONE mechanic at different strengths: percent 1.0 leaves nothing of the chance, so this is the same op and the same buff class as the 35% trace -- there is no second 'immunity' vocabulary to keep in sync. ⚠ The immunity is 长夜's own, so the effect targets the MEMOSPRITE ('target': 'summon'), not her summoner: a control aimed at 「长夜」 asks its own BuffManager, and 长夜月 standing next to it is unaffected by this rule. ⚠ Granted on SUMMONED rather than at BATTLE_START even though both would work: the summon's existence at BATTLE_START depends on the table order of two rules in one event, and 「在场时」 is exactly the lifetime this event already marks. ⚠ 'actor == summon' is required -- SUMMONED reaches every character's table, so without it a teammate's memosprite entering would make HERS immune. ⚠ 'permanent': true, because 「免疫…」 here states no duration and the memosprite is immune for as long as it is on the field (leaving the field removes it with the unit). ⚠ The 「被攻击的概率提高」 half of the same sentence is already carried by the memosprite spec's `aggro` (125, from the ServantID block), and 「「长夜」在场时…伤害提高50%」 is registered rather than approximated.

source: 1413 长夜月 忆灵技能 2 孤独，浮游，漆黑 (效果ID 10000011): 「「长夜」免疫控制类负面状态，被攻击的概率提高。「长夜」在场时，长夜月和「长夜」造成的伤害提高50%。」参数（全部等级）= [0.25…0.7, 3] ⇒ 第一个 = 正文点名的 50%（Lv6 = 0.5）、第二个 = 未被正文引用的恒定 3
note: 「「长夜」**被攻击的概率提高**」—— 数值是**未被正文引用的那个参数** ✓：① 忆灵技能2 的参数表是 `[0.25…0.7, 3]` ✓，第一个值就是正文点名的「伤害提高 **50%**」（Lv6 = 0.5 ✓），第二个是**恒定 3 且正文从不提它** ✓ ⇒ 按同一条方法 ⇒ 软仇恨比率 **3** ⇒ 权重 **×(1+3) = ×4** ✓（⭐ 这是该方法的**第四次**命中：1001 第 5 个参数 = 5、1107 第 2 个 = 5、1110 第 6 个 = 5、这里第 2 个 = 3 ✓）。② 上游 `Config/ConfigAbility/Servant/Servant_EvernightServant_00_Ability.json` 的属性集合恰好是 `{AggroAddedRatio, AllDamageTypeAddedRatio, SpeedAddedRatio}` ✓，其中 `MServant_EvernightServant_00_Passive` 在 `OnStack` 里写 `AggroAddedRatio` ✓ ⇒ 忆灵确实自带一个软仇恨权重 ✓（引擎侧的基础权重是忆灵规格里的 `"aggro": 125` ✓ ⇒ 125 × 4 = **500** ✓）。⚠ **同一句的前半段早已出货** ✓：`characters/1413.json` 里已有 `RESIST_DEBUFF kind control percent 1.0 permanent target summon` ✓ ⇒ 「免疫控制类负面状态」**不需要**再动 ✓；⭐ 这恰好解释了为什么忆灵文件里**一个免疫类属性都没有** ✓（`Immune`/`Immunity`/`StatusResistance`/`DebuffResist` 在该文件里各 **0** 次 ✓）—— 因为那一半是用**满抗性**建模的 ✓。⚠ 写法与同文件另两条 `SUMMONED` 规则一致 ✓（`when: ["actor == summon"]` + `target: summon` ✓）；⚠ 技能 1/3/4/5 与「在场时伤害提高 50%」的其余部分**不在本条**（前者是技能数据、后者是增益 ✓，已在别的规则里 ✓）。

source: 1413 长夜月 终结技 晚安，全世界无眠 (skill 141303, Ultimate/AoEAttack/Ice): 「召唤忆灵「长夜」，随后使忆灵「长夜」对敌方全体造成等同于「长夜」#1[i]%生命上限的冰属性伤害，并使长夜月进入【至暗之谜】状态，期间敌方全体受到的伤害提高#4[i]%，长夜月和忆灵「长夜」造成的伤害提高#3[i]%，且免疫控制类负面状态。」 param Lv10 = [2, 2, 0.6, 0.3]
note: Two effects, in the order the text writes them: 召唤忆灵 then 使忆灵…造成伤害. ⚠ The three numbers of that attack are NOT written here -- `skill: "ULTRA"` + `damage_param: 0` reads the multiplier out of 141303's own parameter row and the element (Ice) and shape (AoEAttack) come from the same skill data. ⚠ `damage_param` is a 0-based array index while the document writes its placeholders 1-based: the Max HP share is `#1[i]`, so the column is 0. Writing 1 reads `#2[i]` -- the 【至暗之谜】 charge count, which is 2 at EVERY level and happens to equal 2.0 at Lv10 -- so a wrong index would look right until the level moved (that is what the level-ratio case in SummonCommandTest caught). ⚠ `damage_level: 10` is likewise required, not decoration: a character's skills are all at level 1 in this engine, so the skill's own level would read the Lv1 row (1.0) while the text quotes the Lv10 row (2.0) -- half the damage, with nothing to report. The multiplier is 2.5 at the skill's cap (Lv15). Only `attribute: HEALTH` is stated, because that is the one thing the row does not say: 「等同于**忆灵**的生命上限」, not 长夜月's ATK. A first draft of this op carried its own element/shape/percent fields and would have been a second copy of data that already exists. ⚠ `actor == self` is not decoration: ULT_CAST is delivered to every character's table, so without it a teammate's ultimate would command HER memosprite. ⚠ The summon acts without spending its turn -- this is an extra attack, like a follow-up, and 「长夜」's own turn still uses its own skill (50% of its Max HP, single target). ⚠ NOT authored from the ultimate: 【至暗之谜】 (a state with charges, an enemy vulnerability of 30%, a 60% damage boost for both units, crowd-control immunity) -- that is a state machine with its own resource, registered rather than approximated. ⚠ The **90 toughness** of that all-enemy attack rides along HERE, and reads the same skill's `stance_list.all` -- the commanded attack is the swing that removes it (`SkillExecutor`'s AOE arm is skipped for a delegated cast; measured 2026-09-27: a 300-point bar goes 300 -> 210, i.e. exactly 90; `SummonCommandTest.castingTheUltimateRemovesTheToughnessItsOwnSkillStates`). Giving this op a stance argument would be a second copy of the number and would remove it twice. ⚠ The double damage that this rule used to cause is FIXED, by the CAST_SETUP rule above: without it the engine's own path swung 141303's rows at HER attack as the base (measured 8818.5 on 1002011 with an empty table) and this rule swung the memosprite's share on top, where the document describes one damage instance. Registered as M-40 and closed on 2026-09-27 (`CastSetupTest`).
